_header.description: console.log/debug baseline for non-test src under packages/ and apps/. New hits fail check:console-baseline; shrink via --update-baselines after removing hits. Every entry carries an adjudicated reason; regeneration preserves reasons (merge by file+text) and refuses to write entries without one.
